segments.ja309:1.1: Sabbamidaṃ carimaṃ kataṃ [carimavataṃ (sī. pī.)], ubho dhammaṃ na passare;
segments.ja309:1.3: Ubho pakatiyā cutā, yo cāyaṃ mantejjhāpeti [mantajjhāyati (sī.), sajjhāpayati (pī.)];
segments.ja309:2.3: Tasmā etaṃ na sevāmi, dhammaṃ isīhi sevitaṃ.
segments.ja309:3.3: Mā taṃ adhammo ācarito, asmā kumbhamivābhidā.
